title: Michael Jackson Hee-Hee
blurb: The most famous vocal ad-lib in pop history, now doing service as an all-purpose exclamation of flair. Michael Jackson used it as punctuation — a rhythmic hiccup between lines, entirely percussive, meaning nothing on its own — which is exactly why it lifts out of the music so cleanly. Anything performed with a little extra style has earned it: a smooth move, a dramatic exit, a moment of confidence nobody has verified. Play it when somebody does something ordinary with unnecessary panache. Undefeated as a stylistic full stop.
origin: Michael Jackson's signature vocal ad-lib, meme shorthand for doing anything with flair.
